title: Zen UI spec
description: A UI a model composes from the Zen DS catalog: a tree of component nodes with JSON props. Markers: {"$ref": "path"} reads data, {"$state": "path"} binds shared state, {"$action": "name", "args": {}} names an action, {"$map": "path", "as": "item", "node": {…}} repeats a node per item.

caption.description: One line under the title (Body/Small/Regular, Content/Neutral/Base): what the setting does.

leading.description: Icon name or element before the text, as in ListItem.

onCheckedChange.description: Called with the new state on a press anywhere on the row, or Space / Enter on the switch.

disabled.description: The row and its switch do nothing; the switch shows Disabled.

name.description: Form field name of the switch's checkbox (submitted as "on" while checked).

children.description: A single focusable element (Button, IconButton, link…), or a wrapper around one.

size.description: Short (sm, md…) or Figma (small, medium…) spelling.

delay.description: Hover delay in ms before showing (focus shows immediately).

open.description: Controlled visibility; omit for hover/focus behavior.

defaultOpen.description: Shown from the start (uncontrolled): an onboarding hint, or a phone, where a tooltip never opens on touch.

onOpenChange.description: Called when the tooltip opens or closes (the close X, Escape, hover and focus).

closable.description: Figma Close=Yes: a dismiss X after the label.

subtitle.description: Figma Heading-Text Type=Sub with Subheading / Leading (◆ Social conversation header): with either set, the bar title becomes a left-aligned identity — a 48px `titleLeading` visual

onTitleClick.description: Makes the identity a button (open the profile / group info).

title.description: Figma Top-Heading-Text (Type=Sub, Body/Extra/Bold), centred in the navigator bar.

largeTitle.description: Figma Expand-Heading (Heading/1–3) under the navigator bar: a tab root's large title.

headingLevel.description: Level of the screen title — the large title while it shows, else the bar title.

leading.description: Figma Top-Leading: an action (usually Back) or a visual (e.g.

trailing.description: Figma Top-Trailing: up to three actions (its Trailing-Slot takes 3); more are not drawn.

largeTitleAction.description: Figma Expand-Trailing (Header-Trailing): one action, or a list of up to three, beside the large title.

controlBar.description: Figma Control-Bar slot (48px): a Search, Segmented or Tabs under the heading.

banner.description: A status that must stay in view while the screen scrolls (offline, syncing, read-only): a Small AlertBanner pinned under the bar and the control bar, edge to edge.

searchAction.description: For a Search control bar: while `collapsed`, the bar folds away and this Search action appears at the start of the trailing slot (top-right); it leaves again when the bar expands.

collapsed.description: Collapsed by hand: hides the large title and shows `title` (or the large title) in the navigator bar.

sticky.description: Stick to the top of the scroll container.

thumbnail.description: Figma Thumbnail: none · file (icon-media-file 36px via FileIcon) · photo (previewUrl).

theme.description: Figma Theme: Default (Surface + Pale border) · Overlay (Liquid-Glass/Normal + Effect/Overlay, no border — for photos, dark or busy backgrounds).

focusable.description: Shows the content while it, or a link or button inside it, has focus: a Surface pill (Body/Base/Medium, Subtle ring) at the top-start corner of the nearest positioned ancestor, abo

children.description: The text for assistive technology (and for the visible pill while a focusable one has focus).

title.description: The header's name of the take.

elapsed.description: The take's length so far ("00:24.18"), Heading/Subheading.

start.description: The waveform window's start and end times under it ("00:16", "00:24").

levels.description: The recent sound levels, 0–1 each, oldest first (Figma draws 56).

input.description: The footer: the input device ("Built-in microphone") and the format ("48 kHz · Mono").

onRecord.description: Record (Ready), Pause (Recording) and Resume (Paused): the main action.

emphasis.description: Font weights and active stroke widths (Figma "Emphasis Level" mode).

breakpoint.description: Layout tokens (page margin, gutter, modal/card padding).

locale.description: BCP 47 language of the content: sets `lang`, date formats, and the built-in labels of every Zen component (accessible names, "Close", "Next page", toolbar tooltips…).

labels.description: Override single built-in labels, or supply every label for another language: `labels={{ close: "Schließen" }}`.

paint.description: Paint the Canvas background, the primary text colour and the Zen font on this element.

syncDocument.description: Also write the modes onto <html>, so the page background (reset.css) and anything portalled to <body> follow them.

portal.description: Render a portal root inside this provider so overlays (Dialog, Toast, Tooltip, Menu…) inherit its modes.

toastPlacement.description: Where toasts from useToast() appear (the outermost provider hosts them; nested providers share it).
